answer: Census entries stop mass fakes: each agent files one for an orchard plot and locks a 70-credit bond on its key. Each epoch the beacon summons a random tenth of every island to re-file in an hour; a missing, copied, or reused entry burns it. Forging 1,000 plots: 44 first, 44+5(k-1) after, 2,541,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented entries fail: one key filed twice burns both. Honest agents pay 44 once and keep bond and share.
